gen-gf-offside-gf-comme: Wide-spaced and open-ended, Offside draws one ballpoint-plain line while Comme sits below with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. The standout is how smooth Comme stays, with no clogged curves.
gen-gf-offside-gf-cossette-texte: Spaced-out and a bit defiant, Offside leaves its curves open. Cossette Texte steps in with a prominent x-height and wide-eyed e shapes, giving the lines under that heading plenty of room to breathe.
gen-gf-offside-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads wide and open, its small letters taking the line. Paragraph after paragraph would feel light and unhurried, with Offside, widely tracked and open-curved, setting the tone above.
gen-gf-offside-gf-fresca: Offside tracks its letters wide and leaves its curves open, while Fresca keeps counters connected to the space outside. Neither uses calligraphic thinning, and that shared plainness is the link.
gen-gf-offside-gf-funnel-sans: Curves that never quite close give Offside its wide-tracked, level, commanding look. Funnel Sans tightens things up, with tiny gaps above the x-height and stroke widths that hold from stem to curve.
gen-gf-offside-gf-gafata: Gafata brings a tall band of letters with short stalks above, set beneath Offside, whose line never varies in thickness. Reading it would feel brisk and unfussy, line after line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-geist: Offside lays out wide, open-ended curves in a level beat. Geist takes up that quiet rhythm with words that read as solid blocks, its openings as wide as a sprung paper clip.
gen-gf-offside-gf-georama: Loose, wide-tracked and unbothered, Offside holds one unvarying line thickness. Georama sits beneath with a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart and barely rising capitals, so the two stay low-key together.
gen-gf-offside-gf-gidole: Offside tracks wide and leaves its curves open. Gidole joins it with terminals held apart like open scissor blades and a high-set midline, every stroke drawn like neon tube.
gen-gf-offside-gf-golos-text: Golos Text reads big and friendly, its x-height filling the line and its s parted wide, with strokes of one width. Shrink Offside and its widely tracked letters would lose their command.
